summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the process of importing campaign frames into the system. [p1] confirmed that all frames have been successfully imported into the system via a provided spreadsheet link. A key technical point was established: matching by `frame->>'mapa_frame_id'` is the recommended method for linking the frame ID to the database record.

[p1] described manually downloading presentation images, which is time-consuming. [me] advised that this manual process is difficult and noted that such imports often lack technical challenges but involve significant effort.
decisions: Use `frame->>'mapa_frame_id'` for matching frame IDs to the database record.
